Boussole citoyenne (civic-compass) · slice design sheet

Swiss politics launcher

A static launcher for Swiss politics: the next ballot, the parties from left to right, decision aids and official sites, fed by a sourced JSON referential. One slice covers the whole site: 9 screens, no HTTP API, 8 modules, 5 data files.

Follows PRD-0001: Swiss politics launcher PRD of 2026-11-16, draft Code as merged on main, 2026-11-16
PRD-0001.US-01 PRD-0001.US-02 PRD-0001.US-03 PRD-0001.US-04 PRD-0001.US-05 PRD-0001.US-06 PRD-0001.US-07 PRD-0001.US-08 PRD-0001.US-09 PRD-0001.US-10 PRD-0001.US-11 PRD-0001.US-12

What the voter sees

Four pages, one territory sheet and one menu, all at phone width (390 px), captured from the built site. Every page reads the territory chosen once (US-05) and shows only what concerns it. The copy is the real French copy of the site.

ScreenStoryAddressReads
Ballot listUS-01#votation/<territory>ballot items, cantonal items of the territory
Ballot item, 3 tabsUS-02, US-03, US-04#votation/<territory>one ballot item, its sourced party recommendations, tool and state site URLs by id
Territory sheetUS-05over any pagethe 26 cantons, which are covered, which vote on a cantonal item
PartiesUS-06#partis/<territory>parties of the territory, in file order
Decision aidsUS-07#aides/<territory>tools listed by id, the territory's voting page
Official sitesUS-08#etat/<territory>state sites of the territory with a URL
MenuUS-08over any pagefour state-site shortcuts for the territory

Ballot list (US-01)

Home page. The date and a countdown, the number of items, when the voting material arrives, then the numbered items with their question. With a canton chosen, a line names its cantonal items or links its voting page.

Ballot item: Comprendre (US-02)

One item, three tabs. The first gives what a yes and a no change, the Federal Council and Parliament recommendation when recorded, the note "Résumé indicatif. La brochure officielle fait foi.", then links to the official page, the brochure, easyvote and Vimentis. Back and next buttons move between items.

Ballot item: Comparer (US-03)

The national parties as a half-circle, left to right, coloured yes, no or "À confirmer". Only recommendations with a source under the chart are coloured. Then smartvote, smartmonitor and Swissvotes.

Ballot item: Décider (US-04)

The practical steps (material received, postal vote or vote at the commune, whom to ask), then the voting page of the chosen canton and ch.ch.

Territory sheet (US-05)

Opened by the territory bar on every page. "Confédération", then a tile map of the 26 cantons: covered cantons selectable, the others "Bientôt" and disabled, a dot on cantons with a cantonal item on 29 November. Closes by the close button, the backdrop or Escape, and gives focus back to the territory bar.

Parties (US-06)

One sector per party, left to right in the order of the data file, the chosen party and its rank in the centre. The card shows the name, a line of description, the position, the facts that have a source, and the party site, or a search link when no site is known. Facts without a source are not shown: on 2026-11-16 none has one, so no card shows them.

Decision aids (US-07)

Three steps: Comprendre, Comparer, Décider. Each tool shows its name, what it does and its host; the last step links the territory's voting page and the next ballot.

Official sites (US-08)

The official sites of the territory in one list, with a search that ignores accents and case. An empty result says so.

Menu (US-08)

A hamburger on a phone, open on a computer. Two groups: "Je veux..." (the three pages) and "Voir ce que fait l'État" (Lire une loi, Trouver un élu, Voir les résultats, Consulter les chiffres, Tous les sites), whose links follow the territory.

Decisions on this layer

Settled
  • Mobile first: the voter's device is a phone; the menu folds into a hamburger on a phone and is open on a computer.PRD-0001 §5
  • The Confederation design system gives the look, without its coat of arms or logos; the site says it is independent and not official.PRD-0001 §5
  • A recommendation is coloured only when sourced; every other party reads "À confirmer".PRD-0001.US-03
  • A party fact appears only with a source and a check date.PRD-0001.US-06PRD-0001 §8
  • A party with no known site gets a search link, never a guessed address.PRD-0001.US-06PRD-0001.US-10
  • Uncovered cantons stay on the map, marked "Bientôt" and disabled.PRD-0001.US-05
  • Keyboard access to the half-circle, the map and the sheet, ARIA labels on sectors and tiles, focus returned on close.PRD-0001 §5
  • Editorial tone: airy, numbered lists, no long dash in any text.PRD-0001 §5
Left to the implementation
  • The exact countdown wording and the breakpoint where the menu unfolds.
  • The order of the tools inside each step of the decision aids.

No HTTP API

The site is static: no server of its own, no account, no request to a backend. Every piece of data is inside the script at build time, so there is no OpenAPI document. What it does have are contracts: the address a voter can share, what the browser remembers, the files the build produces, and the commands the maintainer runs.

NameWhat it doesDirectionCarrier
Page addressOpens a page for a territory; changes when the voter movesVoter to site, site to address barURL fragment #<page>/<territory>
Remembered territoryRestores the last territory on the next visitSite to browser and backBrowser storage, 2 keys
Built siteWhat GitHub Pages serves and what opens from diskBuild to visitordist/
npm run buildBundles the site and its data into dist/Maintainer, CICommand
npm run checkType-checks the code and validates data/*.jsonMaintainer, CICommand
npm run linksTests every current URL of the referentialMaintainer, CI each push and MondayCommand
npm run seatsFetches the 2023 National Council seats from the OFSMaintainerCommand

Page address

Shareable and bookmarkable. Read on load and on every change of the fragment; rewritten (without a new history entry) when the voter changes page or territory.

PartValuesWhen absent or unknown
pagevotation, partis, aides, etatThe ballot page
territoryfederal, or the lower-case code of a covered canton (ge, vd, vs, ne, ju, fr)The remembered territory, else the Confederation
short form#<territory> aloneRead as the ballot page of that territory

The page segments stay in French for now: they are the addresses voters may have shared.

Remembered territory

KeyValueRead
civic-compass.scopefederal or a lower-case canton codeAt start, when the address names no territory
civic-compass.cantonThe last canton chosen, upper caseAt start, if that canton is still covered

Written each time the territory changes. Any storage error is ignored: the site works without it, in a private window too.

Built site

FileContract
dist/index.htmlLoads one classic script (not a module), so it also works when opened from disk
dist/js/site.jsOne self-contained script (IIFE) with data/*.json inside; no request at run time
dist/css/, dist/LICENSECopied as they are: css/site.css, the design system stylesheet and fonts, the licence

Commands

All run by Node 26 straight from TypeScript, through tools/cli.ts (check, links, seats) and tools/build.ts. Messages are in French. Common option: --data folder, data/ by default.

CommandReadsWrites or printsExit code
buildsrc/site/, data/*.json, index.html, css/Replaces dist/; prints the bundle size0 built, other on a build error
checkCode, data/*.jsonEach error with its file and entry, or a one-line summary of the counts0 valid, 1 errors (type or data)
linksEvery current URL of data/*.json, never previous_urlsEach link that is not plainly OK, with its reason and where it is used, then a summary; --all also lists the OK ones0 nothing failing, 1 a link fails (table below)
seatsThe OFS CSV of the 2023 election; --url to override--show: the columns and first rows; else data/seats-national-council-2023.json, the parties recognised and the total to compare with 2000 done, 2 download failed or columns not found
(none, or unknown)The help2 (0 with --help)

Link verdicts

Each URL is fetched with redirects followed, a 25 s limit and up to 3 attempts. The first matching row decides.

OrderWhenVerdictShown asFails the run
1The final address is on another registered domain (a parked domain, a search engine)elsewhereAILLEURSYes
2403 or 429: the site refuses robotsblockedÀ VOIRNo
35xx or network error: retried after 1 s, then 3 s; still failingbrokenCASSÉYes
4No answer in time after every attemptunreachableÀ VOIRNo
5Any other status that is not 2xx (404, 410...)brokenCASSÉYes
62xx after a redirect on the same domainredirectedOKNo
72xx at the same addressokOKNo

Decisions on this layer

Settled
  • No backend, no account, no tracking; the only stored state is the territory, in the visitor's own browser.PRD-0001 §3
  • The page and territory live in the address, so a page can be shared.PRD-0001.US-05
  • The built site works from disk: one classic script with the data inside.PRD-0001.US-12PRD-0001 §6
  • A redirect to another domain fails the link check; previous URLs are never tested.PRD-0001.US-11PRD-0001.US-10
  • Refused robots and timeouts are listed for a manual check and never fail, locally or in CI.PRD-0001.US-11PRD-0001 §8
  • The data check and the link check run on every push and pull request, the link check also every Monday.PRD-0001.US-11PRD-0001.US-12
Left to the implementation
  • The timeout, the number of attempts and the waits between them.
  • How many links are tested at once.
  • The exact wording of the console messages.

What each module owns

TypeScript only, with English names. The site is a few ES modules bundled into one script; the tooling runs on Node 26 straight from its .ts files. One file of types describes the data for both.

ModuleOwnsTested by
src/types.tsThe interfaces of the referential, a schema next to each, and the list of data files. The schema type makes the compiler fail if a schema misses a key, adds one, or gets an optional or nullable flag wrong.tsc; used by check
src/site/referential.tsThe data as the site sees it: imports data/*.json at build time, the Confederation level, the covered cantons (any canton with parties), the tools with a URL, URL lookup by id.check guarantees the shapes it trusts; parity run
src/site/links.tsThe ids of the state sites and tools the site links to by name (menu shortcuts, item tabs, aids). No URL in code.check fails if an id is missing or has no URL
src/site/app.tsRouting and address, remembered territory, menu, territory sheet and tile map, parties half-circle and card, decision aids, official sites with search. Exposes the current territory and a render hook.Parity run; tsc
src/site/ballot.tsThe ballot page: list, item page, the three tabs, the mini half-circle of recommendations. Re-renders when the territory changes.Parity run; tsc
src/site/dom.ts, main.tsSmall helpers (element lookup, HTML escaping, accent-free search, host name); the entry point that starts both pages.tsc
tools/cli.tsThe maintainer's commands: check (schemas, then cross checks), links, seats.Run on deliberately broken data and on a local server (redirect to a search engine, 503 then 200)
tools/build.tsBundles src/site/main.ts with esbuild as one classic script, copies the page, styles and licence into dist/.Opening dist/index.html from disk

Reused unchanged: index.html, the Confederation design system stylesheet and fonts, css/site.css.

How the modules depend on each other

One run: choose Geneva, open a party

How it is checked

CheckWhat it provesWhere it runs
tsc on two configurationsThe site (browser types) and the tooling (Node types) compile; schemas match their interfacesnpm run check, CI
Referential checkEvery data file matches its schema, then: unique ids and codes, known territories, url null exactly when not found, ballot recommendations only for existing national parties, every id the site links to existsnpm run check, CI
Link checkCurrent URLs answer and stay on their domain (decision table in the previous tab)npm run links, CI on each push and every Monday
Parity runDuring the migration, the old site and the new dist/ were driven through the same 29 steps in headless Chromium: 27 identical renders, 2 differing only where the old script crashed on a shorter party listOnce, by hand; not automated

There are no unit tests of the rendering code: the screens are checked by eye and by the parity run, the data by the referential check.

Decisions on this layer

Settled
  • One language, TypeScript, for the site and the tooling; the tooling runs on Node 26 with no compile step.PRD-0001 §6
  • Development dependencies only: typescript, esbuild, @types/node, pinned exactly.PRD-0001 §6
  • One file of types describes the data; site and check both use it.PRD-0001 §6PRD-0001.US-09
  • No URL in the site code: links are looked up by id in the referential.PRD-0001.US-08
  • Code names in English, everything shown on the site in French.PRD-0001 §6
  • Routes, markup and behaviour are those of the site before the migration.PRD-0001 §6
Left to the implementation
  • How the rendering code is split inside app.ts and ballot.ts.
  • Whether the parity run becomes an automated test.

No database: five JSON files

There is no database and no server. The "tables" are five JSON files in data/, edited by hand and checked by npm run check, then copied into the script at build time. Each file wraps its content in one key, next to a free _readme note for editors. Row counts are those of 2026-11-16.

FileHoldsRows
territories.jsonThe Confederation (CH) and the 26 cantons; a canton is covered once it has parties27
parties.jsonParties per territory, left to right: the order of the array is the order on screen. 33 verified, 2 to confirm, 16 not found51
state-sites.jsonOfficial sites per territory, the canton's own site first. 14 verified, 1 to confirm15
tools.jsonDecision aids, valid for every territory. All verified7
ballot.jsonThe next ballot: 4 items, 7 sourced party recommendations, 6 cantonal entries, 3 sources1

Nested in these rows: 10 previous URLs and 18 party facts, all 18 still without a source.

Entities and relations

Field conventions

ConventionRuleEnforced by
Keysid unique across parties, state sites and tools; code unique among territories; ballot item ids uniquecheck
Referencesparty.territory and state_site.territory name a territory.code; the keys of ballot.cantons name a canton; the keys of a ballot item's parties name the abbr of a CH partycheck
Link statusstatus is verified, to_confirm or not_found; url is null exactly when the status is not_found; the site shows only verified links and never the status itselfcheck
ProofEvery link entry carries checked_on and evidence (for example the page title); a URL or a recommendation is never added without a sourcecheck for the fields; review for the source
Previous URLsAn abandoned address moves to previous_urls with seen_on and a note; never tested by linkscheck, links
Sourced factsA fact is {value, source, checked_on}; the site shows it only when source is setSite rendering
DatesISO YYYY-MM-DD, real calendar datescheck
LanguageKeys and enum values in English, values (names, descriptions, notes) in FrenchReview

Decisions on this layer

Settled
  • The data lives in one JSON file per referential, not in code.PRD-0001.US-09
  • Every link records its status, check date, evidence and previous addresses.PRD-0001.US-10
  • A canton is available as soon as it has parties in the parties file.PRD-0001.US-09
  • Only verified links reach the voter; to_confirm and not_found are internal to the maintainer.PRD-0001 §8PRD-0001.US-10
  • Facts without a source are kept in the data but not shown.PRD-0001 §8PRD-0001.US-06
  • Party recommendations exist only for national parties and only with a listed source.PRD-0001.US-03
  • The data is embedded at build time; nothing is fetched at run time.PRD-0001.US-12
Left to the implementation
  • The order of keys inside an entry and the indentation of the files.
  • The wording of the _readme notes.
